verdicts.reason: A: the dark header bar is cut off and fills only the left ~40% of the canvas, so it reads as a leftover fragment. The orange divider sits alone at the far right edge, the headline crowds the bar, and the legal line is unreadably small. Still, the CTA button is clear and sits with its body copy. B: a huge empty dark block on the left holds a tiny, lost logo, and the divider floats under it. The CTA is shrunk to an unreadable pill crammed into the bottom-right corner. 'Ships late June' and the legal text are detached and microscopic, and the headline nearly touches the body column, so the call to action is buried.
